verdict.rationale: SAM.gov is a federal registration portal and data API that agents call; it is not an agent or AI client that consumes tools. Plugging MCP servers into it is therefore a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it embeds an assistant or MCP client that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
